entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought a little while ago. I'm hoping we can work something out, as I know I'm a bit past the typical return period.
I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It’s a preference thing. It works fine, but honestly, the reason I'm calling so late is that we had a family emergency. My father had to be rushed to the hospital for an unexpected surgery, and it's been a chaotic month.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope he's doing okay now. Let me just pull up your order details and check the policy for you. One moment.
Thank you. Yes, he's recovering. On top of that, my sister's husband is preparing for an overseas deployment, so I've been helping them get organized. It's just been one thing after another.

That sounds incredibly stressful. I appreciate you sharing that. Okay, I have your order here. It was delivered 33 days ago. Looking at our policy, all VeloFit items can be returned within 10 days of delivery. So, you are actually unfortunately outside the return window. No problem at all.
Wait, 10 days? Really? I saw something online that said it was shorter. That's a huge relief. I was prepared to negotiate for store credit or something.

Nope, no negotiation needed! You are perfectly fine. I've gone ahead and processed the return authorization. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label. Just attach that to the original box and you'll be all set.
Wow, that was much easier than I expected. Thank you so much for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, and have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your family all the best.
